description: Preflight an x402 resource manifest: URL, price, receiving address and its EIP-55 checksum, asset, network and authorization window. Before calling or listing an x402 endpoint, to catch a misconfigured requirement. Do not choose this when you need the live 402 challenge fetched, which needs a request. Example requests: Preflight this x402 endpoint before I call it. | Is this x402 payment requirement safe to pay? | Check my endpoint's payTo address and price. | Will a stock x402 client be able to buy from this endpoint?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

endpoint.description: The customer's endpoint.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The x402 manifest: a payment requirement, or a resource with an accepts[] list. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_x402_endpoint_preflight
title: x402 endpoint preflight
